sentence: I was watch TV when the phone rang.
ruleVi: Quá khứ tiếp diễn: was / were + V-ing.

sentence: My parents was having dinner when I got home.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ số nhiều (my parents) đi với were trong quá khứ tiếp diễn.

sentence: What did you doing at eight o'clock last night?
ruleVi: Hỏi việc đang làm ở một thời điểm quá khứ: What were you doing?

sentence: When the teacher was coming in, we were talking.
ruleVi: Hành động ngắn xen vào dùng quá khứ đơn (came), việc đang diễn ra dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn.

sentence: It raining heavily at six o'clock this morning.
ruleVi: Quá khứ tiếp diễn cần was / were; it đi với was.

sentence: I was siting on the bus when I saw her.
ruleVi: Was + V-ing; sit gấp đôi t thành sitting.

sentence: Was you studying at ten o'clock last night?
ruleVi: Câu hỏi quá khứ tiếp diễn với you: Were you + V-ing?

sentence: We wasn't sleeping when the earthquake happened.
ruleVi: Phủ định với we là weren't + V-ing.

sentence: While Lan was walking home, she was meeting an old friend.
ruleVi: Việc xảy ra chen vào lúc đang đi (while ...) dùng quá khứ đơn: met.

sentence: The children were play in the garden when it got dark.
ruleVi: Sau were phải là V-ing: were playing.
